/* Synchronous listener-hub collection-37 publisher for a newly armed battle-intro pose category.
   
   Source: SoulcaliburVI.exe 0x1404009D0; active hub vtable 0x14337C4F8 slot +0x130; caller
   0x140385F10.
   
   Parameters:
   pDispatcher - embedded ULuxBattleEventListenerHub dispatcher at hub +0x28.
   pEvent - exact 8-byte packet: +0 uint player slot, +4 int selected pose category.
   
   Returns:
   void after all live collection-37 callbacks run and invalid entries are compacted.
   
   Algorithm:
   Copy the player slot and pose category into an 8-byte stack packet, then synchronously dispatch
   listener-hub collection 37 at dispatcher +0x1038 (hub +0x1060).
   
   Verified producer:
   LuxBattle_PlayerIntro_ActivateNextChara arms the selected ENST pose scheduler first, increments
   its configured-pose count, transitions to wait state, then calls this virtual slot. Categories
   4/0 are first-pose choices and 5/1 later choices; authored fixed categories use their configured
   value.
   
   Rollback relevance:
   BattleManager registers HandleBattleManagerD40Event on this collection. That callback broadcasts
   manager +0xD40, causing linked-actor phase clearing, before it publishes manager +0x1462 and
   clears +0x1594. Preserve the scheduler-arm -> collection37 -> manager-field-update ordering. */

void DispatchLuxBattlePoseCategoryArmedEvent
               (FLuxVfxDispatcher_Partial *pDispatcher,FLuxBattleManagerEventD40_Partial *pEvent)

{
  uint dwField0;
  uint dwField1;
  
  dwField0 = pEvent->dwPlayerSlot;
  dwField1 = pEvent->nPoseCategory;
  ProcessAndCompactCallbackEntries
            ((FCallbackEntryCollection_Partial *)(pDispatcher + 0x207),&dwField0);
  return;
}
